what.text: This page follows refugees from Colombia living in Canada, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 12709 Colombian refugees in Canada, 16.0% of all refugees from Colombia.
Ecuador hosts the most Colombian refugees, followed by Venezuela, Canada and Costa Rica.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Colombia in every year from 1989 to 2025, with the ELN, EPL, FARC and EPL–Los Pelusos among the opponents.
It records the conflict at war level in some of those years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 101 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 17563, at the end of 2012, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2004 to 2015 and 2024 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
These are year-end totals for Canada only, reported to UNHCR.
